magicMoments.title: Setting the facilitation philosophy
magicMoments.quote: I am not here to teach, I am here to facilitate. Facilitation is about planting seeds.
magicMoments.context: Nick opened with this philosophy statement, immediately calibrating participant expectations away from passive learning towards active engagement.

magicMoments.title: Framing the AI simulation
magicMoments.quote: What I want you to notice is that when you interact with these characters, they behave exactly like a real person would.
magicMoments.context: Introduced the Arrow AI simulation to both EMEA cohorts together — generating curiosity and a shared sense of 'this is different' before the program had even started.

magicMoments.title: Opening with a provocation
magicMoments.quote: Why do you think we're learning about finance in the age of AI?
magicMoments.context: Rather than opening with a learning objective slide, Nick led with a question that placed participants' current reality front and centre — immediately making finance feel relevant before any content was taught.

magicMoments.title: Co-constructing the cost framework
magicMoments.context: Instead of explaining fixed vs variable costs from a slide, Nick built the framework iteratively from examples volunteered by participants. The group felt they had arrived at the framework themselves.

magicMoments.title: Using Zena to debrief assumptions
magicMoments.quote: What did Zena tell you that surprised you?
magicMoments.context: After the simulation, Nick positioned Zena (the AI character) as a third voice in the debrief — asking what she pushed back on — creating productive distance from participants' own assumptions.

magicMoments.title: Redirecting the in-room finance expert
magicMoments.quote: Mark, I want to reframe your role here today. You're not a participant, you're a coach.
magicMoments.context: Mark Norman — an experienced finance professional — was in the cohort. Rather than letting this create a 'knowing vs learning' dynamic, Nick pre-empted it by repositioning Mark as a coach. This protected psychological safety for everyone else and turned a potential disruption into an asset.

magicMoments.title: Consistent Socratic questioning
magicMoments.quote: How did you arrive at that recommendation?
magicMoments.context: Throughout the debrief, Nick consistently asked 'how did you get there?' rather than validating or correcting — keeping the reasoning with participants and reinforcing that the insight was theirs to own.

magicMoments.title: Building the monitoring framework from the room
magicMoments.context: In the final debrief, Nick co-constructed the 90-day monitoring framework from participant outputs rather than revealing a pre-prepared answer — giving the group full ownership of the conclusion.
